Rank 16 - Community

Mosque, Maktab, and Donation Manager

Mosque committees need transparent donation, expense, maktab fee, and announcement records.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 7,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 300Recommended monthly charge

BDT 300/month is suitable if setup is paid and reports are fixed. Keep this low-cost and trust-focused.

7.4Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 7,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 300Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 10,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target local mosques, maktabs, Islamic schools, and community committees that track donations, expenses, and student fees manually.

Donation and expense records can become sensitive when notebooks are unclear.

The committee can show clear monthly income and expenses.

Validation signals

  • Mosques and maktabs are everywhere.
  • Transparency is valuable.
  • Monthly reports are recurring.
  • Simple printed reports can build trust.

MVP modules

  • Donation record
  • Expense record
  • Maktab student fee
  • Teacher payment
  • Monthly balance
  • Announcement list
  • Printable report

Do not build first

  • Do not custody donations first.
  • Do not add political content.
  • Do not force online payment.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Start with known community committees.
  • Create monthly report template.
  • Train one treasurer.
  • Add public notice page later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Trust sensitivity.
  • Low budget.
  • Committee changes.
Mitigations
  • Transparent logs.
  • Annual low-cost plan.
  • Easy admin transfer.
